top_signals.title: Asian Bonds Follow Treasuries Lower, Stocks Rise: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian bonds declined and the dollar remained under pressure after a rally in Treasuries faded, with investors betting that US efforts to contain long-term borrowing costs through buybacks may offer only a temporary reprieve.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
